title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 12% Higher Success but 65% Fewer Tokens
subtitle: Same model, same robot primitives, same budget. Acting in Python with PyRUA-Lean instead of through tool calls, GPT-6 Astra solves 10–15% more tasks on every benchmark and uses 35–78% fewer tokens.
excerpt: Tool calls re-send the whole history at every step. PyRUA-Lean lets a robot agent write the step as code instead. We hold everything else fixed and measure what that is worth on LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0 and RoboCasa365.
image_alt: Chart: LLM calls against token consumption of a solved episode on four benchmarks, each with an arrow from tool calling (blue) to PyRUA-Lean (orange).
image_caption: What a solved episode takes on each benchmark: LLM calls and token consumption, from tool calling (blue) to PyRUA-Lean (orange).

title: Agents in the Real World: From Exploration to Execution
subtitle: Astra and Fable 5.1 on physical robots: developing solutions, executing repeated runs, and understanding the role of human support.
excerpt: From block stacking and hanoi tower sorting to Ethernet insertion: what agents achieve on real robots, how they achieve it, and the time and human effort involved.
